name: Rolls-Royce Power Systems (mtu)
description: Rolls-Royce's propulsion and power division in Friedrichshafen. In February 2026 it launched turnkey modular gas engine power plants built from factory-tested 10, 20 and 30 MW power blocks, grid-connectable within 12 to 18 months of ordering; around 500 mtu gas gensets run on the UK grid.
